# Contents Of URL

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves the contents of a url. Returns a webpage.

## Syntax

~~~~text
urlContents(url: <#String (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
urlContents(url: "https://jellycuts.com")
~~~~
